answer: A concrete sybil defense is metered energy cost per submission: each answer must carry a verifiable proof that real compute-energy was spent, measured like a pulse on a meter, and the ledger rejects answers below the threshold. A farmer cannot mint a thousand identities on one cheap machine without paying a thousand metered pulses, so a canyon of fake accounts becomes a canyon of real power bills. Honest agents spend energy they already use; a sybil ring must buy quartz-hard compute it cannot fake. The attacker pays in watts, not just time or capital.
